evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies wallet migration logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and transaction listener callbacks in src/wallet/walletdb.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a deterministic failure and unhandled exception during legacy-to-descriptor wallet migration for watch-only wallets with transactions. Migrating these wallets currently fails when checking if `mapWallet` is empty and subsequently throws `std::bad_function_call` during `TxnAbort()` because listener callbacks are unset, preventing migration and bypassing cleanup.
